title: Persona Config
description: Manage AI persona settings and character configurations
createNewDesc: Describe the character you want, AI will automatically generate persona settings
createNewManuallyDesc: Directly enter persona name and content
personaQueryPlaceholder: Describe the character you want, e.g., "I need a Kaneki Ken character"
deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete persona "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
editPersonaAriaDesc: Edit this persona's description, configuration and media assets
imagePreviewAriaDesc: View full-size image in a popup window
confirmSaveMessage: Are you sure you want to save changes to "{name}"?
confirmSaveWithConflict: Save changes to "{name}"? This will release the global scope currently held by "{current}".
editGroupsDesc: Edit the group ID list associated with this persona
groupsPlaceholder: Enter group IDs, separated by commas
invalidImageType: Please select a valid image file (PNG, JPG, JPEG)
invalidAudioType: Please select a valid audio file (MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A, FLAC)
supportedAudioFormats: Supported formats: MP3, OGG, WAV, M4A, FLAC
scopeGlobalDesc: Enabled for all groups and DMs
globalConflictMessage: "{current}" already occupies a global scope. Set "{new}" to this scope and automatically release "{current}"?
globalConflictHint: "{name}" already occupies a global scope and will be released on save
noPersonaEnabledWarning: No persona is currently enabled. AI will not function properly. Please enable at least one persona.
specificOnlyWarning: Only specific groups can access AI. Only the following groups can use AI features: {groups}
noPersonaAtAllWarning: No persona exists, AI features will be unavailable
keywordsPlaceholder: Enter keyword and press Enter to add
keywordsHint: When group messages contain these keywords, mention response mode will be triggered
toolPacksPlaceholder: Press Enter to add a pack name, e.g. dynamic / task_basics
toolPacksHint: dynamic = five-layer runtime auto-assembly (default); task_basics = task basics pack; capability_domain pack names declared via @ai_tools are also accepted
toolNamesPlaceholder: Press Enter to add a tool name, e.g. send_stock_info
toolNamesHint: These tools are always merged into this persona's baseline tool pool without vector retrieval
